description: Builds an A-pose model-sheet prompt from a saved card's look and, with FAL_KEY set, generates it on fal.ai: a faceless figure built from the card's body (the proportions they were born with, as life events changed them, plus their posture) is drawn front and back and given to GPT Image as the pose reference, with the full look → concept.png (the card is re-rendered with it). pose_image puts the character in the pose of any picture → concept-pose.png. Every sheet drawn on the card's figure also gets its avatar for free: a square crop of the front view's head, face in the centre, saved as avatar.png (avatar-<style>.png for a style variant) and returned with its box. Without FAL_KEY (or with dry_run) returns the prompt only. Paid: tell the user the price from character_next and wait for a yes.

avatar.description: Also cut the avatar from the sheet (default true, free): two files come back, the sheet and avatar.png. false = the sheet only.

control_scale.description: ControlNet modes: how strictly to follow the condition (default 0.75).

dry_run.description: Only return the prompt, do not call the image API. It is exactly the prompt the real run would send for the same options.

extra.description: Extra art direction appended to the prompt the image model gets, in every mode.

figure.description: The figure drawing. Default: skeleton for gpt; for the other modes blocking-lit (zone colours with volume), or shaded without look.blocking. Also blocking (flat colour patches), flat, mask.

mode.description: How the figure steers the image. gpt (default, GPT Image edit): the figure is a pose reference. img2img (Z-Image): it is the starting canvas; greys colours. pose/depth/canny: ControlNet conditions (weak on this endpoint). Kept for experiments; leave unset.

pose_image.description: Path, URL or data URI of a picture whose pose the character should take (e.g. their idle pose or signature gesture).

seed.description: Seed, to reproduce or vary a result.

strength.description: img2img: how much to repaint the mannequin (default 0.85 ≈ 7 of 8 steps; lower keeps the pose harder but greys the colours, higher frees colours but loses the pose).

style.description: Omit for the library's house style (CHARACTER_FORGE_ART_STYLE if set, else the built-in one; one look across the library). 'card' = the designer's suggestion in look.art_style; or any style text, e.g. 'anime cel-shaded'. Non-default styles are saved as concept-<style>.png next to concept.png.

views.description: Views on the sheet. Default front-back.

name: character_concept
title: Generate A-pose concept sheet
